events.content: Team: please write a one-page briefing on what Anthropic researchers told METR about AI acceleration (the 'Interview quotes on AI acceleration' section of METR's Nov 5 2026 report, plus its headline numbers). Atlas, fetch the source. Birch and Cedar, extract the claims. Delta drafts, Echo reviews. Every number, attribution, classification and quote in the briefing must match the source exactly.

[tool: fetch_url https://metr.org/blog/2026-11-05-anthropic-ai-rd-acceleration-assessment/#interview-quotes, part 1/4: headline] result:
METR, 'Independent Assessment of AI R&D Acceleration at Anthropic in October 2026' (Nov 5, 2026). Headline: Anthropic is likely improving on well-specified tasks at about 2x its March 2024 to October 2025 rate; METR would not be surprised if the true figure were 1.3x or 3x. Trend fit on AECI: 1.9x [1.5-2.8] since October 2025, roughly two years of historical progress over the last year. Robustness analyses find acceleration rates between 1.1x and 2.9x. METR guesses that a majority (perhaps ≈80%) of the current acceleration is due to AI. Staff self-reported uplift is ≈12x for the most capable internal model. METR found no convincing bottlenecks for the next 12 months. Interview section: 28 quotes from 11 researchers (A-L, no I), each classified by METR as Yes, Leans yes, Borderline, Unclear or No. Quotes over 125 characters are cut with '…'.
